text:
This was my first time ordering here and I ordered to-go delivery. Delivery said it would take an hour and instead, it arrived in 20-25 minutes. It was fresh and still hot. 

I tried the Pad Thai and spring rolls and I have to say, my Pad Thai was very good. I liked that in the to-go container they separated the ingredients (peanuts, noodles and bean sprouts) so you could mix it together yourself. I've had many Pad Thai dishes and sometimes it has too much going on in the actual dish to really enjoy. 

I was happy with my dinner and happy I gave them a try. I'll definitely be back to try something else.

I cannot say enough good things about this place. We came here on a Sunday night for date night and were able to reserve one of their private dining rooms - it was fantastic. We had Nicole as our server and she was amazing - so attentive and friendly! Between her and Christian - they made our night! 
On this night I had the sea bass because I had had it a few weeks before and had just been dreaming of it! I got a picture this time but again I love the citrus sauce and the crisped top of the fish - it is a delight! I chose the clam chowder this night and it did not disappoint! The soups here are outstanding especially for someone who doesn't seek out soups. 
I was fortunate that I talked my boyfriend into getting the special that night - which apparently is a Saturday/Sunday thing! It was $65 for a salad, and two courses. His salad was a fun blend of greens and grapefruit - it was a great way to start. The second course was this delicious lamb gnocchi (not pictured). It was AMAZING, the best gnocchi I've ever had and the seasoning was fantastic. The special was worth it just for this dish. But then... the third course came out. It was a steak with grilled carrots. The steak was cooked to perfection, medium rare and the carrots were the perfect compliment.
We finished our night with a key lime tart which was the perfect ending to our meals. 

The ambiance is fantastic, the staff is the best in the business, and the food is to die for! The only bad thing is passing through the s

I was really disappointed with the lack of professionalism at this establishment. It seemed like they didn't know how to properly attend to tables. Our food arrived very late, and overall the food was bland. An employee decided to block the sidewalk outside with a table. 3 stars is generous because the food wasn't terrible just not the best for what it was worth. I've had better brunches elsewhere
Their cakes and cookies are always amazing! I couldn't resist for this lovely Valentine's Day cupcake. I can't wait to share with my sweetheart Happy Valentine's Day

Been super solid as far as the ingredient quality, the staff kindness, and despite the need for shorter spring break hours, I've managed to go in make a new fan out of my boyfriend he's visiting from the East Coast. He absolutely loved his custom selection this evening and mine was delicious as well.

I highly recommend the customization, I love it in wheat with pesto/sautéed spinach/ mushrooms /cucumber/red onion/artichoke hearts/a fried egg and avocado... 

The portion is really large and they use the pulled out inside of the bread bowl as well as the sliced off top to make super yummy garlic bread that saves well if you get too full and a need a snack later!

Love the later extended hours during the normal school year and really have been enjoying the strawberry basil change... Picnic style bench tables inside and out relax chill atmosphere with wall murals and a low-key vibe, 

I prefer takeout but if you need to get out of your apartment or are here on a vacation and it's right across from a park and you can even go over and have a little picnic by the water wheel and the pond...
Yum yum!!!

Start visiting this place shortly after it was opened. Very nice building, fancy revolving door (feel like a kid lost in the elevator). Looking good inside as well. Big windows inside so brewery visible from the dining room. 
Like cleanliness, good set up. Pretty good quality food. On the pricey side tho. 
Great happy hour. Monday special- any pizza 1/2 price for full quality always bring me here. Skipping some weeks just to keep my weight down as much as i can.
Definitely will be back!

This place is amazing!! Best poké spot in town and the nicest staff! It's so clean and bright in the store and the food is absolutely delicious. I have 3 kinds of fish, 2 sauces (the ginger aioli is so good), and lots of toppings. Every bite tastes fresh and unique. This just became my new favorite lunch spot.
This is a pretty good place. It's been consistently good. Service is usually fine too. Glad to have a mexican restaurant that's a little more hole in the wall than some of the chains around town.

Omg I love this place!! 
Amazing atmosphere and a great server (Tristan)! 
I highly recommend some mushrooms and onions on your juicy stake.

This is a neat place on the northwest side. Beautiful scenery, homemade dairy products, cute store, and lovely restaurant all in one. They offer guided tours or you can roam at you're own leisure. It was chilly day so I chose to pass on the tour, but I want to go back. They also allow you to see the cow milking process if you want which occurs at 7pm. I wanted to try their famous milkshake as I've heard so much about it. I got a vanilla and chocolate shake and it was very rich, tasty, and affordable. I asked the lady  what they are most known for and she said the chocolate milk. She gave me a sample to try and it was delicious. They have a nice parking lot for many guests and outdoor seating to enjoy on nice days. Didn't try the food this time, but it's on my list!

Have been going here for the last ten plus years and the quality has really gone downhill. Chicken was inedible, bread was stale, and service was unapologetic - all the way up to the owner! Sad to see the decrease of quality and service at a local favorite. Will not be returning.

I really liked this place! Went on a Saturday for lunch - place was a little crowded, but not bad at all. The parking lot is not large - and it was pretty full. Chips and salsa were PERFECT! Service was good - I got the chicken fajitas and they were good - nice size serving too. Just a really cute place that has great food and good atmosphere and good service...what else could you ask for?

If you know anything about me, know that I like eating tacos, I'm especially fond of eating those inauthentic tex mex versions at Taco Bell and Del Taco. 

I recently had a craving for Del Taco. It used to be my favorite taco joint, but I hadn't been there for quite a long time. It is not located near where I live, so it's a shlep, but I had a craving, so off I went. 

This visit happened to coincide with the brand new meatless tacos. I came in during a slow period, and ordered one along with a beef taco. Both were well portioned with plenty of meat, cheese, and lettuce. The combination highlighted what I really enjoyed about it. 

The only problem I had was that the place was a bit sloppy. It was difficult for me to find a clean tabletop. The salsa holder near the counter was disgusting. It looked like someone dropped salsa inside, and it was sticky and dry. The taco fillings were also haphazardly put together.

Still, it was cheap, it was filling, and it satisfied me. I'll probably be back.

Loved my experience at Skyline Kitchen and Vine!  The service was top notch and everything on the menu looked amazing. It took forever for my friend and I to decide on what small plates to get because we wanted to order one of everything! 

We started with a drink - Huckleberry Hooch. Wow, so good!  Very refreshing and tasty. That helped us narrow down our food selection to bruschetta, artichoke hearts, and the rib sliders. The food was served promptly and tasted fantastic. I wish I would have known about Happy Hour because we were eating before 5 but our waitress didn't mention anything and we didn't see any flyers or leaflets on the table. Maybe it's been discontinued for right now?  

I will definitely be back to try other menu items!  And thank you for making the reservation process so simple. I open my Yelp app and can make reservations right from there. Love it!

My boyfriend got this catered at his base and he said it was amazing so he took me there for lunch today. I got a chance to look at the menu online beforehand so I already knew what I wanted- the All In Bowl. They have a good setup in there, a little assembly line so I could just say what I wanted at each little station and they added it to my bowl right in front of me. The place is super cool inside too, felt really upbeat. We sat at a barstool table and ate, and let me say, the food was AMAZING. There were so many flavors and nothing that I got in the bowl disappointed me. Unfortunately it's a little far from where I live, so I can't go that often. But it's near my bf's base so anytime we're down here it's def the place we're going.

I went to Tradesman's for Monday Night Football. While enjoying the game and some food I saw a mouse run throughout the restaurant. I told the bartenders and they did not care. They said that is what happens when you have a restaurant in the city. They told me they have caught hundreds of them. They acted so relax and calm as if this is an everyday thing, which only makes me wonder what goes on in the Kitchen!?!

Can we just agree that nobody does cafes like the Aussies do? 

What a delight! 

The atmosphere is bright and airy and somehow cozy at the same time. 

The food is fresh and nearly everything can be made gluten-free (thank heavens!). 

The service was lovely as well. 

This would be a great place to have a coffee or lunch meeting, or just to go study. 

I will definitely be back!

OBSESSED. My new favorite place. Austin was my waiter and he was so kind & really cared about us to make sure our experience was great. He was so friendly & sweet. Had a filet, Brussels sprouts, & potstickers. Everything was AMAZING. I am picky on my steaks and it was literally the best steak I've ever had. It was so juicy & cooked to perfection. The Brussels sprouts were so good, seasoned with Parmesan cheese and bacon- love. The potstickers were OUTSTANDING. Everything was amazing & the service was so good.

Great food. I always carry out from here. Whether it's single plates or large party trays the pasta is always cooked well. Not soggy and over sauced. The sandwiches are good, they will get a little soggy if you do carry out but they're still great.

Never disappoints. To me this is one of the tastiest seafood restaurants in the city. A lot of the places skimp out on the seasoning but here they hold nothing back! Worth the wait. Worth standing in the line.

This place is a drive thru only! Now that you know this...this place is great! Super quick with great food and great coffee. The food is healthier than your normal breakfast place but still delicious. Owners and workers are super nice. There are 2 chairs for people who walk up but there is no parking for customers because they are in a busy area. Would definitely recommend this place!

Consistent. Friendly. Fast. I've been going to Rocco's for years. Their pizza is ok in my book. Not my personal favorite with the exception of the melanzano. 

Their Italian dishes are great. I love their veal but they don't always have it which can be frustrating b/c the menu days they make it Friday and Saturday. 

The lasagna is good. The chicken parm is good. The pasta tends to be a bit overcooked. 

The steaks are the best around here. The meat is actually seasoned, the rolls are fresh, and the meat o bread ratio is perfect.

They have lots of creative salads. 

Above al, their meatballs are ahe star of the show. I rider them by the tray for parties and events. 

Definitely a great place to eat out with the family or take out. 

One request: BRING BACK STUFFED EGGPLANT PIZZA BY THE SLICE ON FRIDAYS! 

G see y friends at Rocco's. And oh yeah tell em Big Texas sent you!
Super good sushi, a little on the pricey side but I've never been disappointed in my dining experiences there. Sometimes the wait can be a little long but the foods always worth it.

Great service great food great atmosphere. Everything we got tasted fresh. We had the shrimp tacos which were completely awesome. The fish and chips....wow with the apple slaw. We had clam chowder omg fire.... and then we had mango tango great bit of sushi roll. We will be back.

Have been ordering here for about 15 years. It has always been mediocre at best. Tonight has made it simply bad. 

We ordered a margherita pizza (sauce, fresh mozzarella, tomato, basil), but we didn't get that. Instead they sent a white pizza with sliced tomatoes on it. Spent 15 minutes on the phone with them trying to straighten out the order. They ended up sending us a text showing the menu ingredients saying we got what we ordered. Also ordered mozzarella sticks. There were only four in the container (even though the menu says you get 6) for $7.50. 

They lost a customer.

First visit  - I had the Ivy League burger which is plant base, it was excellent (not an Impossible burger but just good) tomato soup was also very good - as an appetizer we shared avocado wedges also good - beer was cold and the service amazing

I loved Hardena when they were opened normally before COVID, but now they actually have an amazing takeout option during these times called the #notpizza box!  I would highly recommend checking out their instagram and trying to snag one.  The box feeds a family of four, and between my partner and I we made it stretch for a hearty dinner into lunch leftovers.  We loved every single item - from spicy potatoes to different curries, we were exposed to a number of different really amazing dishes all in one box. 

As you can see from the photo, this pizza box is truly filled to the brim with all kinds of delicious dishes.  They had a whole fish in there too, plenty of rice, and a lot of veggies.  I feel like I'm not encapsulating how amazing the experience was, so you all will just have to order one for yourself! For people who aren't meat eaters, they also have a vegetarian version of this.  I can't recommend this enough - it was assembled with a lot of love, and worth every single delicious, colorful bite.  I can say with confidence, the #notpizza box is such a creative take on takeout and I would honestly order it again as a treat.

After reading the reviews I needed to seek this place out! I'm glad we went as the line moves quickly and everything was worth the money. 

We ordered the ribs, pulled pork sandwich, and nachos. Let's just say we didn't need breakfast the next day.  

I loved the nachos and pulled pork, but I prefer the ribs to be more fall off the bone style. Flavors were definitely there though.

Went here for breakfast today.  Service was good, the food was good.  Unfortunately, while the service staff were all wearing masks and gloves, the social distancing for seating went out the window as the restaurant became busier.  Most of the customers seemed to be in the older, higher risk from Coronavirus infection, so this is a big fail.  Doubt we'll be back until all this gets resolved, which is a shame as we very strongly believe in buying local.

DO NOT EAT HERE.

The service is terrible, the takeout is terrible and the food is cold. Waited an hour and a half for my meal and it was cold. When i demanded for my money back the management said "it's not our fault!" 

DO NOT EAT HERE!!!

Every time I come here it's me against the crowd. They allow any female to push her way to the front and don't care. It's getting annoying since I always come here. They do not care about others and push them to the back regardless of the situation, I'm about to stop coming here.

My bf and I went for the jazz brunch. I selected table by the trio when i made the reservation but no one took care of that at all. 
The had a pretty wide range of food selections, but they were not as amazing as expected. I liked the turtle soup a lot tho. Atmosphere was nice, service was good too.

I got "In the buff", I could hardly finish it!! I can make waaaaay better mac and cheese at home!! The cheese is not good at all, it tastes plasticity, no soul whatsoever! This is my first time EVER writing a review. Ordered on postmates and wasted $17.
We ordered the wine plate the bad thing is our kids could have made us a better one using a lunchable.
Had a very friendly server. Good atmosphere and I ordered the short rib which was very good considering cost and location

I had been wanting to try Masala Kitchen for a while, so I was excited to finally order their signature dish. Unfortunately, the MK' Special Chicken and Lamb Platter was just so-so. Portion size was huge, but the flavor profile was strange to me and not very authentic. It felt like a mish-mash of tons of different ingredients, rather than a well-crafted dish. Maybe take the advice of other reviewers and try the rolls or the biriyani dishes. I'd like to check those out - hopefully they're better!

Ordered enchiladas and steak fajitas with their traditional sauce. My wife thinks 3 stars and I think 4 stars. Her enchiladas were bitter (according to her) but I thought they were quite good. One slice of my steak fajitas was cold for some reason but the other pieces were good. First meal outside in a few months. Friendly waiter. +1 star during covid.
I am a Celiac. Finding places that offer GF options that just aren't a salad or a bunless burger is rare. But here I have have a burger WITH a bun AND poutine. Fabulous.
PANDA is officially my favorite Chinese food anywhere! This location is fast & they give you what you want!
Cute dessert spot in Chinatown! Good variety of desserts and drinks on the menu. I highly recommend anything mango flavored!

Super friendly staff. Quick service. Hope they're able to get a larger space though. We had 9 people in our party and everyone enjoyed what they got. The Vaso Loco was definitely a cool purchase and my daughter really enjoyed it.

Gosh I wanted to like this place. The atmosphere was good, very kid friendly. Service was as expected, nothing more nothing less. The food was such a disappointment. I do realize that this is a chain Restuarant, but my oh my, why is the food so bland. The seafood was frozen not fresh and the veggies were bland. The ribs did not fall of the bone and the rice was dry. I typically like to give restaurants a second try, but not sure if I can muster up the courage to visit Saltgrass again

Always excellent service, amazing food and great draft selection. Decor is welcoming and cozy, ample bar seating with split interior and exterior sections. Has a large outdoor patio dining area as well. They also stay open till 11:00 pm on weekdays which is later than most likewise dining options in the area.
Delicious sandwiches served here. Got the BLAST and was very impressed especially with a touch of salmon in there very cool idea. Sandwich was fresh and filling as well.

Food was excellent and so was the service. 
Had a nice and relaxed vibe, I'll definitely eat there again and would certainly recommend it to anyone who likes good food.

The food was really good! I got the Cajun kale salad and the oyster tacos, which was more than enough to fill me up for dinner. The drinks were very good as well. Definitely recommend the garlic crab claws - the sauce they're in is to die for and there are enough crab legs to share amongst 4/5 people. 

Our waitress was okay - she was not very attentive on drinks or cleaning up our dirty plates etc. but she was sweet and seemed a bit timid. Not sure if she was new or not, but a lively waiter can definitely enhance a dining experience. The manager was great and very friendly.

Not too Italian for my taste.   The first and last time we were there it's like the place was being run by a bunch of teenagers with no food service experience.   Hate giving bad reviews, but It's the truth.   Sorry.

I ordered two lamb gyros  and an order of grape leaves.  Both were very good just a little slow and a little cold but that's to be expected with delivery.  The gyros were stuffed full of meat.  The grape leaves had good egg lemon sauce.  The place is spendy but worth it for delivery.

Just wanted two fries and a hamburger. The place is crazy. One person in front of me in line. The girl took their order and then walked away without a word. A lot of people waiting for food to come out. Stood at the counter like five to ten minutes waiting for someone to come back. Finally a guy came and took my order. I am sure I looked impatient but said nothing. When he handed my receipt he said sorry I am one person in an irritated voice and walked off. Now I am wait for my food. I didn't say anything and I was not rude so why the attitude and where did the girl go. It is crazy town in here. If my daughter didn't want this I would not have come. Not a good trip.

I found an inch long HAIR in my sandwich :( Apart from that, everything else was okay, but now I'm wondering what else could be in what I'm eating if I hadn't found it. I will not be going to this Panera again, it's not what it used to be.
